The `_make_api_call` wrapper starts an `OP.HTTP_CLIENT` span via `_start_client_span`. During that call, the stdlib HTTP instrumentation can also start an `OP.HTTP_CLIENT` span under the active boto3 span; the change only adjusts that child’s activation, not whether it is created. Thus a boto3 call using that HTTP path starts more than one client span.
YES
